qa_pairs.question: What is the purpose of the Metrix portal for Alliance users?
qa_pairs.answer: The Metrix portal is a website designed for Alliance users. It uses information gathered from compute nodes and management servers to create interactive data, allowing users to track their real-time resource usage, such as CPU, GPU, memory, and file system.

qa_pairs.question: Which Alliance clusters have dedicated Metrix portals listed, and what are their corresponding URLs?
qa_pairs.answer: The Metrix portal lists dedicated portals for the Rorqual, Narval, Nibi, tamIA, and Vulcan clusters. Their respective URLs are https://metrix.rorqual.alliancecan.ca, http://metrix.narval.alliancecan.ca, https://portal.nibi.sharcnet.ca, https://portail.tamia.ecpia.ca, and http://metrix.vulcan.alliancecan.ca.
